description: I smell strong gas coming from the kitchen and I hear a hissing noise near the stove!
There are sparks and smoke shooting out of the main electrical wall socket in the living room!
Main water pipe burst in the bathroom ceiling, water is pouring like a waterfall and the apartment is flooding quickly.
The front door lock is completely jammed from the outside and will not lock. Anyone can push it open.
Water is leaking under the kitchen sink and the floor is wet whenever the tap runs.
One of the bedroom light bulbs keeps flickering intermittently.
The bathroom door handle is a bit loose and squeaks when turned.
Something is wrong with the door.
The kitchen thing is not working today, please check.
Hari umwotsi n'ibirimi by'umuriro birimo gusohoka mu nsinga z'amashanyarazi mu cyumba cyanjye!
Amazi menshi arimo kumeneka munsi y'urugi rw'ubwogero, hasi hose huzuye amazi.
Urugi rw'idirishya ntirufunga neza iyo umuyaga uhushye.
